name: Registry export (nightly D1 fleet registry snapshot)

knobs.note: BH-5651: how many nightly snapshots bin/registry-export.sh --snapshot keeps under state/registry/export/ (newest first; older ones are deleted). Read as ${REGISTRY_EXPORT_KEEP:-14} after the settings resolution; 0 and a non-numeric value also mean 14, because a snapshot lane that keeps nothing is no disaster-recovery copy. --keep N on the command line wins.

Test seam: epoch seconds bin/registry-export.sh --snapshot names the snapshot directory after, instead of now (tests/registry-export.bh-5651-test.sh runs several snapshots in one second). NOT settable from the control plane.
